property_summary: After calling cancelProposal(1,2) with appropriate preconditions, the reference contract has VADER set (non-zero) while the buggy contract has VADER = address(0), causing the moveUtils call to revert on the buggy contract but succeed on the reference.
change_summary: Delete the assignment to VADER (the line 'VADER = _vader;') so that VADER remains its default value (address(0)).
